description: Commit 4: Firestore rules for games and usage, games composite index, 16 new rules tests, attack-case comment block A17-A21. Independent of FEAT-001/002 code (touches only firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, rules-test/).
steps: Read firestore.rules header (A1-A16/N1-N6 block) and helpers (signedIn, existing, adultLinkedTo). Append the A17-A21 'Phase 2 cases' comment block before the closing // ==== line per design sec 6.1.

Insert the `match /games/{gameId}` block (get,list: signedIn && (existing().createdBy == request.auth.uid || adultLinkedTo(existing().createdBy)); create,update,delete: false) and `match /usage/{id}` (read,write: false) after the leaderboard match block and before the users match. Check existing() semantics against how it is used for list queries elsewhere in the file.
Add the games composite index (createdBy ASC, createdAt DESC, COLLECTION scope) to firestore.indexes.json keeping existing indexes.

Append the 16 tests of design sec 6.3 to rules-test/rules.test.js with a seedGame helper, each negative paired with a positive control. For the adult list query (test 15 / A21), determine in the emulator whether a createdBy-pinned list is accepted for the consented-adult branch; if rejected, switch rules to `allow get` (creator or adultLinkedTo) and `allow list` (creator only), adjust the tests and the A21 comment accordingly, and record the outcome in findings.
Update rules-test/README.md test count/notes briefly. Commit: 'feat(rules): games and usage rules with tests (A17-A21)'.
acceptance_criteria: rules suite reports 69 passing (53 existing + 16 new), 0 failing, from real output
firestore.rules header lists A17-A21; clients cannot create/update/delete games or touch usage
firestore.indexes.json is valid JSON and keeps prior indexes
verification: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-mathquest "node --test rules-test/rules.test.js" -> 69 pass
findings: EXECUTED: emulator rules suite 69 tests, 69 pass, 0 fail (53 existing + 16 new G1-G16); indexes JSON parses. Open point resolved in the emulator: a list query pinned with where(createdBy==studentUid) IS accepted for a consented (accepted/approved) adult, so rules kept as `allow get, list` (creator or adultLinkedTo); no fallback needed (G15 asserts adult pinned list ok, unpinned list denied, list pinned to unlinked student denied). Games index (createdBy ASC, createdAt DESC) added, prior 3 links indexes kept. NOT executed: deploy of rules/indexes to the live project; the createdAt-ordered query needs the index only on live Firestore (emulator does not enforce indexes), so the client failed-precondition fallback is untested here. Test seedGame uses fields createdBy/title/questions etc. as a stand-in; rules only read createdBy.
